video.title: AI欧腐《狐狸的掌心兔/The Bunny in the Fox's Palm》
video.desc:
A fox caught an Omega bunny in heat? Between appetite and desire, danger becomes addiction, and natural enemies risk everything to become mates ——“Catch me. Hunt me down. Don't let me run away.”
狐狸捉住了一只发情期的 Omega 兔子？在食欲与情欲之间，危险渐渐成瘾，一对天敌甘愿赌上一切，成为彼此的伴侣。
"抓住我，追捕我，别让我逃掉。"
